title: O salutaris hostia (Willaert)
desc: Adrian Willaert, O salutaris hostia. 6 voices (Superius, Altus I, Altus II, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
